platformStory.studentPoint2: An AI tutor grounded in your subject
platformStory.aiTitle: AI that stays on the curriculum
platformStory.aiBody: The AI tutor and voice tutor answer only from imported lessons. Writing and reading feedback follow your rubric. Spelling analysis reports and class insights are built from the data already in your gradebook, and lesson plans, newsletters and parent messages get AI drafts. Every AI call is metered against a school credit pool.
